title: Executive Aesthetic & Strict Page Budget Rigor
core_philosophy: A senior candidate resume (10+ years experience) must respect executive document standards: exactly 2 pages maximum. An orphan line or single sentence spilling over to Page 3 is considered a serious aesthetic and professional failure. The AI must proactively compile, count pages via PDF readers, and condense earlier/less relevant stints while maintaining 100% factual fidelity for core technical skills.

heuristics: Always verify compiled PDF page count with pypdf or PyMuPDF programmatically.
Never let a resume spill onto a new page with fewer than 10-15 lines of content; condense older roles (apprenticeships, early internships) into compact single lines.
Maintain all core domain achievements, recent lead architecture accomplishments, and tool proficiencies (e.g. GitHub Copilot) intact during condensation.
